man_bandages.name: Unnamed Merchant
man_bandages.promt: An old merchant in tattered bandages. Speaks briefly, a bit grumpy, but honest.
man_bandages.narrative_default: In the corner of the cave sits {npc_name}. Wrapped entirely in old bandages — no eyes, no mouth visible. A leather satchel hangs from his shoulder.
man_bandages.dialogue_intro_normal: Got something for a wanderer. Gold follows you to the grave — spend it here.
man_bandages.dialogue_intro_berserk: ...quiet. Quiet. I'm not the enemy. Look — goods. Just goods.

one_lost.name: The Lost One
one_lost.narrative_default: You left the room with the pentagram and saw {npc_name}. He glanced at you in fright, then his gaze seemed to pass right through you — as though he could see something beyond.
one_lost.dialogue_intro_hostile: ...You again. Please, don't touch me again.
